segments.title: Cold Open & Hype Train Acknowledgments
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on, processes gifted subs and hype train; Case Blackwell takes anchor desk after hype train ends.

segments.title: Elon Musk DOGE Exit & Trump Tariff Reversal
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins for news desk covering Musk reducing DOGE role to 1-2 days/week, cabinet secretaries reasserting control, 71% profit drop at Tesla, Trump walking back 145% China tariffs to 'substantially lower' levels.

segments.title: Cyber Truck Interview Attempt
segments.notes: Case attempts to interview a Cyber Truck; Peter Gibbon emerges from crawlspace claiming to have vandalized all Cyber Trucks with acid sludge; bit devolves into truck hitting orphanage and racing Sonic.

segments.title: Woodchuck Debate & Roe v. Wade Sidetrack
segments.notes: Munch assigns Crum 'overturn Roe v. Wade' position on woodchuck riddle; Crum argues woodchucks would form regressive society restricting reproductive rights, wins $5k toward $140k gorilla debt.

segments.title: Case Investigates Munch Offshore Banking Conspiracy
segments.notes: Case watches '5 Shocking Twitch Moments' YouTube video, finds no evidence of Munch laundering channel points offshore; pivots to suspecting Crum of robbery and money laundering instead.

segments.title: Speed News Roundup with Crum
segments.notes: Rapid-fire stories: gladiator lion bite marks proven, AI hair-washing machines in China, Ferrari 458 burns 1hr after delivery, Fyre Fest 2 cancelled, strap-on penis bank incident, pro-natalist medals proposal, Rock explains WrestleMania no-show, FDA phasing out synthetic dyes, sperm racing league announced.

segments.title: Internet Video Review & Raid
segments.notes: Case and Crum watch viewer-submitted clips: Star Wars parody ad, McCain-Palin rap, Gal Gadot line readings, trap bassoon beats; ends with Hype Train freestyle and raid.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored full broadcast; ran news desk, Munch & Crum oversight, speed news co-host, Amongst the Web host.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on, managed hype train acknowledgments, attempted to vandalize Cyber Truck with sludge.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted news desk covering Musk/DOGE and Trump tariffs; declared middle name 'Air Ripple' upon exit.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Emerged from crawlspace claiming responsibility for Cyber Truck vandalism via acid sludge; assisted in failed truck interview.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Assigned Crum anti-abortion position in woodchuck debate; celebrated Crum's win as own magnanimity; gorilla debt collector looming.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Won woodchuck debate arguing woodchucks would overturn Roe v. Wade; earned $5k toward $140k gorilla debt; co-hosted speed news.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Brief phone call during sperm racing segment asking Case to check lip liner color in her bag; theme music played.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Elon Musk's reduced DOGE role and Trump's tariff walkback before a chaotic Cyber Truck interview derailed by stowaway Peter Gibbon's acid sludge. Munch & Crum debated woodchuck reproductive rights, netting Crum $5,000 toward his $140,000 gorilla debt. The broadcast closed with a speed news roundup including FDA dye bans and the launch of competitive sperm racing, followed by Amongst the Web video reviews and a Hype Train freestyle.
